Preschool to Pre-Kindergarten (3 to 4 Years Old)

Our early learning center (ELC) offers a Reggio Emilia-inspired program for our youngest learners. We believe they are capable, competent, and curious. Our project-based, inquiry-focused curriculum develops essential literacy and numeracy skills in context, meeting each child where they are. You'll discover beautiful, purposeful learning spaces and specialist classes like Chinese and Move & Groove.
Learn More About the Early Learning Center

Our co-curricular program encourages character development through unique and rewarding experiences. Students learn to collaborate, take risks, and persevere. Our Eagles gain a deeper understanding and appreciation of themselves and others through a diverse range of pursuits outside of the classroom.

University is an important milestone in the lifelong learning journey cherished by the SAS community. Our graduates are remarkable young adults, equipped not just for college but for life beyond. After all, education should inspire, not just instruct.

High school learning conferences are in full swing! These sessions provide a vital space for parents and educators to come together, share insights, and align on how to best support each student’s unique path. What an inspiring journey to see the collaboration happening across our campus as we celebrate progress and look ahead to new goals. Thank you to our dedicated teachers and families for your commitment to fostering a strong, supportive community around our Eagles! #SASedu #HighSchool #SASCommunity #LearningConferences

With high school learning conferences starting tomorrow and elementary student-led conferences beginning this Friday, it is the perfect time to prepare for these transformative conversations. To help our families make the most of this time, we are sharing "The Other Side of the Table," an insightful guide featuring advice directly from our SAS educators.⁠ The article explores how to shift the focus toward a growth mindset by looking forward rather than back. Our teachers share why prioritizing the learning process over grades and empowering students to lead the dialogue can turn a standard meeting into a powerful partnership. These conferences are pivotal moments to pause, reflect, and chart a course for the future together as a united team.⁠ Read the full guide at the link in our bio to help prepare for your child's journey ahead!⁠ #SASedu #SASParenting #LearningConferences #StudentLedConferences #SASCommunity

What an unforgettable celebration for the grand opening of our reimagined drama theater! The evening began with a powerful showcase of talent as students took to the stage. Inspiring congratulatory speeches and high-energy snippets of Peter and the Starcatcher filled the room, proving this space is a world-class home for creativity. The improved acoustics and modern design enhanced every performance and created a fully immersive experience for every guest in attendance. Following the final applause, friends and families gathered outside to enjoy snacks and celebrate the milestone together. We extend our deepest gratitude to the generous donors who made this renovation possible. Seeing our middle school students perform with such confidence served as a powerful reminder that these upgrades are an investment in our students’ voices and their ability to collaborate and create. Thank you to everyone who joined us to mark this special night! #SASedu #SASArts #DramaTheater #ImpactOfGiving #SASCommunity

The Spark Issue 6 is officially live! This latest edition explores “Power” in all its different shapes and sizes. Our high school Advanced Topic Newspaper and Feature Writing (ATNFR) students have dived deep into how power manifests in our world—from student voices and pop culture influences to geopolitical tensions and the rise of internet stars like IShowSpeed. We hope our students, staff, and future writers will take a moment to appreciate the incredible effort and research behind these pieces. Head over to the link in our bio or visit www.itsthespark.com to read the full issue! Be sure to follow @thesparksas for more updates as the team begins work on Issue 7. #SASedu #TheSpark #StudentVoice #HighSchool

Still living in the highs of Neverland! Last week, our Drama Theater was filled with magic, stardust, and incredible storytelling as our middle school performing arts students brought Peter and the Starcatcher to life. From shipwrecked sailors to the legendary transformation of a nameless orphan into Peter Pan, the performances were nothing short of spectacular! Our Eagles captivated audiences with their brilliant stagecraft, humor, and heart, proving that imagination truly has no limits. It was a joy to see our community come together to support the cast and crew as they navigated the high seas and found their voices on stage. A huge congratulations to everyone involved in making this production a resounding success! Swipe to relive some of our favorite moments from the show! #SASedu #SASArts #MiddleSchool #MSPerformingArts #PeterAndTheStarcatcher

Our elementary students had a front-row seat to an inspiring performance this morning! We were thrilled to welcome our guests from The Sun Smart Foundation International School in Chennai, India, for a special presentation of their play, The Whisper of the Fields. This beautiful production used art and storytelling to explore the vital themes of environmental stewardship and nature’s gentle resilience. It was a wonderful opportunity for our learners to connect with peers from across the globe and reflect on how we can all work together toward a more sustainable future. Thank you to our visiting performers for sharing your creativity and passion for our planet with the SAS community! #SASedu #Sustainability #ElementarySchool #GlobalConnections

pages.title: Early Learning Center - Preschool & Kindergarten | SAS
blocks: At the heart of our beliefs, actions, and Reggio-inspired philosophy is an understanding and respect for young children as unique, capable, and curious learners. Preschool students and teachers come together each day to investigate, ideate, build relationships, and create shared meaning about the world around them.

We believe children are capable, curious and competent learners. Children are agents of their own learning, demonstrating a strong ability to make their own decisions and advocate positive contributions to their community.
The early learning center environment is intentional, flexible, and reflective. It prompts relationships, communication, collaboration, and exploration.

In our preschool, teachers observe and listen to children, asking questions to discover their ideas, hypotheses, and theories. With this understanding, teachers act as a support and a resource for children, considering how children’s thinking might be guided toward new discoveries.

We believe that children have 100 different languages of learning, and 100 different ways to express their thoughts, understanding, and creativity. From dancing and painting, to imagining and exploring, to listening and questioning; the possibilities for expression are endless.

Relationships are the heart of our early learning center. Children are ensured a plurality of opportunities to build and develop relationships with teachers, their peers, their learning environment, and our parent community.
